text: You asked: "Name the higher-timeframe trend the case enters with." There is none to name. ma_50 80.24 under ma_200 87.31 and structure_shift BEARISH_CHOCH fail my trend leg: with the average falling C10 permits only shorts, and R11 suppresses the long once the swing low is taken. My elder_5d [10, 10, 7, 6, 10] CORRECTION_REENTRY is a force fragment standing alone (C9). I hold OPPOSE. What would clear it: structure_shift turning bullish with elder >=7 and a served rising average or weekly tide up (R6). Weekly is not served to me.
